It initializes"}, {"line": 382, "text": "        itself with a new ``weakref.WeakKeyDictionary`` the first time"}, {"line": 383, "text": "        it is accessed, returning the same object upon subsequent access."}, {"line": 384, "text": ""}, {"line": 385, "text": "        .. versionchanged:: 1.4 the :class:`.InstanceState` is now used"}, {"line": 386, "text": "           as the key in the weak dictionary rather than the instance"}, {"line": 387, "text": "           itself."}, {"line": 388, "text": ""}, {"line": 389, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 390, "text": ""}, {"line": 391, "text": "        return weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()"}, {"line": 392, "text": ""}, {"line": 393, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 394, "text": "    def coerce(cls, key, value):"}, {"line": 395, "text": "        \"\"\"Given a value, coerce it into the target type."}, {"line": 396, "text": ""}, {"line": 397, "text": "        Can be overridden by custom subclasses to coerce incoming"}, {"line": 398, "text": "        data into a particular type."}, {"line": 399, "text": ""}, {"line": 400, "text": "        By default, raises ``ValueError``."}, {"line": 401, "text": ""}, {"line": 402, "text": "        This method is called in different scenarios depending on if"}, {"line": 403, "text": "        the parent class is of type :class:`.Mutable` or of type"}, {"line": 404, "text": "        :class:`.MutableComposite`.  In the case of the former, it is called"}, {"line": 405, "text": "        for both attribute-set operations as well as during ORM loading"}, {"line": 406, "text": "        operations.  For the latter, it is only called during attribute-set"}, {"line": 407, "text": "        operations; the mechanics of the :func:`.composite` construct"}, {"line": 408, "text": "        handle coercion during load operations."}, {"line": 409, "text": ""}, {"line": 410, "text": ""}, {"line": 411, "text": "        :param key: string name of the ORM-mapped attribute being set."}, {"line": 412, "text": "        :param value: the incoming value."}, {"line": 413, "text": "        :return: the method should return the coerced value, or raise"}, {"line": 414, "text": "         ``ValueError`` if the coercion cannot be completed."}, {"line": 415, "text": ""}, {"line": 416, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 417, "text": "        if value is None:"}, {"line": 418, "text": "            return None"}, {"line": 419, "text": "        msg = \"Attribute '%s' does not accept objects of type %s\""}, {"line": 420, "text": "        raise ValueError(msg % (key, type(value)))"}, {"line": 421, "text": ""}, {"line": 422, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 423, "text": "    def _get_listen_keys(cls, attribute):"}, {"line": 424, "text": "        \"\"\"Given a descriptor attribute, return a ``set()`` of the attribute"}, {"line": 425, "text": "        keys which indicate a change in the state of this attribute."}, {"line": 426, "text": ""}, {"line": 427, "text": "        This is normally just ``set([attribute.key])``, but can be overridden"}, {"line": 428, "text": "        to provide for additional keys.  E.g. a :class:`.MutableComposite`"}, {"line": 429, "text": "        augments this set with the attribute keys associated with the columns"}, {"line": 430, "text": "        that comprise the composite value."}, {"line": 431, "text": ""}, {"line": 432, "text": "        This collection is consulted in the case of intercepting the"}, {"line": 433, "text": "        :meth:`.InstanceEvents.refresh` and"}, {"line": 434, "text": "        :meth:`.InstanceEvents.refresh_flush` events, which pass along a list"}, {"line": 435, "text": "        of attribute names that have been refreshed; the list is compared"}, {"line": 436, "text": "        against this set to determine if action needs to be taken."}, {"line": 437, "text": ""}, {"line": 438, "text": "        .. versionadded:: 1.0.5"}, {"line": 439, "text": ""}, {"line": 440, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 441, "text": "        return {attribute.key}"}, {"line": 442, "text": ""}, {"line": 443, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 444, "text": "    def _listen_on_attribute(cls, attribute, coerce, parent_cls):"}, {"line": 445, "text": "        \"\"\"Establish this type as a mutation listener for the given"}, {"line": 446, "text": "        mapped descriptor."}, {"line": 447, "text": ""}, {"line": 448, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 449, "text": "        key = attribute.key"}, {"line": 450, "text": "        if parent_cls is not attribute.class_:"}, {"line": 451, "text": "            return"}, {"line": 452, "text": ""}, {"line": 453, "text": "        # rely on \"propagate\" here"}, {"line": 454, "text": "        parent_cls = attribute.class_"}, {"line": 455, "text": ""}, {"line": 456, "text": "        listen_keys = cls._get_listen_keys(attribute)"}, {"line": 457, "text": ""}, {"line": 458, "text": "        def load(state, *args):"}, {"line": 459, "text": "            \"\"\"Listen for objects loaded or refreshed."}, {"line": 460, "text": ""}, {"line": 461, "text": "            Wrap the target data member's value with"}, {"line": 462, "text": "            ``Mutable``."}, {"line": 463, "text": ""}, {"line": 464, "text": "            \"\"\""}, {"line": 465, "text": "            val = state.dict.get(key, None)"}, {"line": 466, "text": "            if val is not None:"}, {"line": 467, "text": "                if coerce:"}, {"line": 468, "text": "                    val = cls.coerce(key, val)"}, {"line": 469, "text": "                    state.dict[key] = val"}], "source_version": "b1421c9fd59154e063ac0d0a98dd2370cdb225043de93162d8691361fca728b2"}

function.name: read_source
function.description: Read source lines from the candidate. Includes source_version, a SHA-256 of the complete normalized UTF-8 text.

function.name: search_source
function.description: Literal source search, up to 16 matches.

function.name: source_symbols
function.description: Find source definitions by optional name substring, with line spans. Useful for generated reader factories.

function.name: historical_cases
function.description: Describe the public historical data examples and their producer versions.

function.name: historical_artifact
function.description: Inspect a PUBLIC example's exact pickle opcode/state structure without loading it. Hidden inputs are unavailable.

function.name: run_checks
function.description: Actually execute public checks inside a 1-CPU,1GB,no-network container. current checks current behavior; legacy checks historical examples and current behavior. Hidden inputs are not accessible.

function.name: read_historical_source
function.description: Read immutable producer-version source, not a fixed reader. Same line limits as read_source.

function.name: search_historical_source
function.description: Literal search of immutable old producer source, up to16matches.

function.name: list_sources
function.description: List up to200 source paths; optional prefix or substring query, with total match count.

function.name: apply_edits
function.description: Atomically replace inclusive 1-based line spans. Every source_version must equal the current file hash returned by read_source. All spans in one file refer to the same original version and must not overlap. new is the full replacement text, including needed newlines. Use start_line=end_line=0 and source_version="new" only to create an absent authorized file. Only task-authorized source and tests/test_regression.py may change; all changed Python files must parse.
